q: By the star when it sets...
v.s: By the star when it descends,
v.c: By the stars when they fade away!

q: nor has he lost his direction
v.s: Your companion [i.e., Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
v.c: Your fellow man is neither misguided nor astray.

q: He does not speak of his own desires.
v.s: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
v.c: Nor does he speak of his own whims.

v.s: It is not but a revelation revealed,
v.c: It is only a revelation sent down ˹to him˺.

q: He has been taught by one of tremendous might
v.s: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -
v.c: He has been taught by one ˹angel˺ of mighty power

q: (so powerful that he used only the tip Of one of his 600 wings to lift the city of Sodom). (Whereas Jibra'eel ﵊ usually appeared before Rasulullaah ﷺ in human form)
v.s: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
v.c: and great perfection, who once rose to ˹his˺ true form

q: was on the highest part of the horizon.

(Rasulullaah ﷺ saw Jibra'eel on the eastern horizon with his six hundred wings spread out. They were so large that they even covered the western horizon. The sight was so tremendous that Rasulullaah ﷺ fell unconscious.)
v.s: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
v.c: while on the highest point above the horizon,

v.s: Then he approached and descended
v.c: then he approached ˹the Prophet˺, coming so close

q: (with each end of a bow touching the corresponding end of the other bow)
v.s: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
v.c: that he was only two arms-lengths away or even less.

q: sent that revelation to His slave, which He revealed.

(This refers to the revelation of verse 6 of Surah 93 up to verse 4 of Surah 94 and the proclamation that no person shall enter Jannah until Rasulullaah ﷺ has entered and that no Ummah shall enter Jannah before his Ummah have entered Jannah).
v.s: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].
v.c: Then Allah revealed to His servant what He revealed ˹through Gabriel˺.

q: does not mistake what it sees
(whatever Rasulullaah ﷺ reported that he saw was the absolute truth).
v.s: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
v.c: The ˹Prophet’s˺ heart did not doubt what he saw.

m: Then will you dispute with him
q: (when you have not seen anything like it)?
v.s: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
v.c: How can you ˹O pagans˺ then dispute with him regarding what he saw?

v.s: And he certainly saw him in another descent
v.c: And he certainly saw that ˹angel descend˺ a second time

q: (near the lote tree when Rasulullaah ﷺ went on the miraculous journey of Mi'raaj to the furthest Jannah)...
v.s: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
v.c: at the Lote Tree of the most extreme limit ˹in the seventh heaven˺—

q: (a comfortable dwelling above which is Allaah's Throne).
v.s: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -
v.c: near which is the Garden of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—

q: (Rasulullaah ﷺ saw Jibra'eel ﵊ before he saw)
was covered by that which covered it.
(When the Sidratul Muntahaa was covered by magnificent colours or angels, it assumed a new appearance and became more beautiful beyond description.)
v.s: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
v.c: while the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with ˹heavenly˺ splendours!

q: (saw any less than it was supposed to see)
v.s: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
v.c: The ˹Prophet’s˺ sight never wandered, nor did it overreach.

q: He definitely saw some of Allaah's great Aayaat
v.s: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
v.c: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs.

q: Have you seen Laat and Uzza
(the names of two idols that the Mushrikeen of Makkah worshipped)...
v.s: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?
v.c: Now, have you considered ˹the idols of˺ Lât and ’Uzza,

v.s: And Manāt, the third - the other one?
v.c: and the third one, Manât, as well?

q: (saying that the angels are Allaah's daughters)?
v.s: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
v.c: Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters?

q: This is certainly an unjust distribution.
v.s: That, then, is an unjust division.
v.c: Then this is ˹truly˺ a biased distribution!

q: are merely names which you and your forefathers have kept, for which Allaah has not revealed any permission
guidance has already come to them from
v.s: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which God has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
v.c: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord.

q: Can man have whatever he wishes for?
v.s: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
v.c: Or should every person ˹simply˺ have whatever ˹intercessors˺ they desire?

q: (Man cannot have whatever he desires because)
The Aakhirah and the world belong to Allaah
(and He is the only One Who decides which of his wishes man should have).
v.s: Rather, to God belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
v.c: In fact, to Allah ˹alone˺ belongs this world and the next.

q: How many are the angels in the heavens whose intercession
except after Allaah grants permission for whoever He wills and is pleased
v.s: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after God has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
v.c: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves.

q: Indeed those who do not believe in the Aakhirah give feminine names to the angels...
v.s: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
v.c: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female,

q: possessing any knowledge. They follow only assumptions and assumptions are absolutely useless against the truth
v.s: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
v.c: although they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions. And surely assumptions can in no way replace the truth.

q: So ignore him who turns away from Our advice and who desires only the life of this world.
v.s: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
v.c: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world.

q: is the extent of their knowledge.
(They are concerned only about this world and have no concern for the Aakhirah). (It is therefore futile to persistently preach to them for)
Verily your Rabb knows best about the person who deviated
from His path and He knows best about him who is rightly guided
(and He shall punish or reward them accordingly).
v.s: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
v.c: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided.

q: To Allaah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth so that
He may punish the evil-doers for their
actions and reward those who do good with the best
v.s: And to God belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
v.c: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—

q: major sins and indecent behaviour except for minor sins
(which they sometimes get involved in because no human is free from fault). (However, they are quick to seek Allaah's forgiveness for these sins and Allaah is ready to forgive them because)
Indeed your Rabb is One of infinite mercy. He was best Aware of you when He created you from the earth and when you were foetuses in the wombs of your mothers.
(He knows everything about you and knows you even better than you know yourselves.)
to yourselves. He knows best who is the most pious
v.s: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
v.c: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth and while you were ˹still˺ fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous.

q: Have you seen the person who turns away
v.s: Have you seen the one who turned away
v.c: Have you seen the one who turned away ˹from Islam,˺
v.h: The One Who Returned to Disbelief

q: (spending in charity; when his motives are not met)?
v.s: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
v.c: and ˹initially˺ paid a little ˹for his salvation˺, and then stopped?

q: Does he have knowledge of the unseen so that he can see
(that he will lose all his wealth if he spends in charity)?
v.s: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
v.c: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees ˹the Hereafter˺?

q: Has he not been informed of what appeared in the scriptures of Moosa ﵊...
v.s: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
v.c: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scripture of Moses,

q: ...and in the scriptures of Ibraheem ﵊ who fulfilled
(every task that Allaah entrusted to him)?
v.s: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
v.c: and ˹that of˺ Abraham, who ˹perfectly˺ fulfilled ˹his covenant˺?

q: (That which appeared in these scriptures was)
shall not be burdened With the burden
(Every person will have to suffer the consequences of his own sins without any of his punishment being given to another.)
v.s: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
v.c: ˹They state˺ that no soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another,

v.s: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
v.c: and that each person will only have what they endeavoured towards,

q: his efforts shall soon be seen
v.s: And that his effort is going to be seen -
v.c: and that ˹the outcome of˺ their endeavours will be seen ˹in their record˺,

m: he will be recompensed for it
q: ...after which he will be rewarded in full
v.s: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -
v.c: then they will be fully rewarded,

q: shall surely be to your Rabb
(Who will evaluate your actions and either reward or punish you for them).
v.s: And that to your Lord is the finality
v.c: and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺.

q: (Allaah creates the condition which make people happy or sad.)
v.s: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
v.c: Moreover, He is the One Who brings about joy and sadness.
v.h: It Is All in Allah’s Hands

q: It is only He Who gives death and life.
v.s: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
v.c: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death.

q: Verily it is only He Who created pairs of male and female...
v.s: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
v.c: And He created the pairs—males and females—

v.s: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
v.c: from a sperm-drop when it is emitted.

q: (Just as He created everything the first time,)
(resurrecting them on the Day of Qiyaamah)
v.s: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.
v.c: And it is upon Him to bring about re-creation.

q: Verily He grants wealth and poverty
(to people according to His complete wisdom).
v.s: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
v.c: And He is the One Who enriches and impoverishes.

q: He is the Rabb of Sirius.
(The star Sirius is also known as the Dog Star. It is the brightest star in the sky and can be seen from almost every part of the earth.)
v.s: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.
v.c: And He alone is the Lord of Sirius.

v.s: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad.
v.c: And He destroyed the first ˹people of˺ ’Ȃd,

q: (who are known by some as the later Aad)
v.s: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -
v.c: and ˹then˺ Thamûd, sparing no one.

v.s: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
v.c: And before ˹that He destroyed˺ the people of Noah, who were truly far worse in wrongdoing and transgression.

q: He also overturned the capsized cities
(the city of Sodom and those around her).
v.s: And the overturned towns He hurled down.
v.c: And ˹it was˺ He ˹Who˺ turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down.

q: (This refers to the shower of stones that rained on the people of Lut ﵊.)
v.s: And covered them by that which He covered.
v.c: How overwhelming was what covered ˹them˺!

q: (It is out of Allaah's Mercy that He reminds you of these incidents so that you do not suffer the fate of these nations.)
(instead of learning lessons from these incidents,)
of your Rabb do you doubt
(because of which you do not take heed and choose rather to follow the ill-fated footsteps of the doomed nations)?
v.s: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
v.c: Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute?

v.s: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.
v.c: This ˹Prophet˺ is a warner like earlier ones.

v.s: The Approaching Day has approached.
v.c: The approaching ˹Hour˺ has drawn near.

q: There is none to avert it
v.s: Of it, [from those] besides God, there is no remover.
v.c: None but Allah can disclose it.

v.s: Then at this statement do you wonder?
v.c: Do you find this revelation astonishing,

q: (out of fear for the warnings it sounds)?
v.s: And you laugh and do not weep
v.c: laughing ˹at it˺ and not weeping ˹in awe˺,

q: (instead of accepting its advice, do you rather)
v.s: While you are proudly sporting?
v.c: while persisting in heedlessness?

q: Prostrate to Allaah and worship Him
(if you are wise). (One who recites or hears this verse being recited should perform Sajdah.)
v.s: So prostrate to God and worship [Him].
v.c: Instead, prostrate to Allah and worship ˹Him alone˺!
